kiki.name: Kiki
kiki.summary: Locked at v6 by your 11-18 plan: v4's shorter, higher-shouldered body on all fours with v5's soft brown eye patches. The sentinel stands straight, fore paws tucked high on the chest, the tail as a tripod. Expressions change the face: happy has smiling (lower-lid) eyes and a raised mouth, surprised has wide eyes, shrunk pupils and lifted brows.
kiki.motion: she walks on all fours, turns toward the camera, rises back into the sentinel (her sit/stand), turns her head left and right, runs through every expression, then says her line
open: Locked: changes now need your sign-off (design/kiki/approved.json).

Species read, by a reader with no context (cloud 11-22): meerkat 70 from the silhouette (prairie dog, otter next) and 60 from the 96 px thumbnail (mongoose, weasel next). A weak read; no critique is recorded for this sheet, so the rubric says 'not ready' (pending the species read).

On all fours she still reads as a mongoose. A picture for your call: design/proposals/kiki-v8/ (a darker crescent mask, a straighter, taller sentinel that levels its head to talk; the all-fours body unchanged). It passes every motion check. Say yes / no to the mask and the stance.
kiki.runners: Both runner-ups are small head/eye/ear morphs from the loop, scored 10.0 without a species read, so they aren't comparable with the current design's score.
kiki.ask: nothing: locked v6 (v4 body, v5 patches) per your 11-18 plan; notes still welcome

zuri.name: Zuri
zuri.summary: Locked at v4 by your 11-18 plan: v3's stockier zebra (deeper chest, thicker neck and legs, bigger head, real hooves) with a soft brush mane in place of the saw-toothed crest. Lids drawn up at rest; expressions change the face as for all five.
open: Locked: changes now need your sign-off (design/zuri/approved.json).

Species read, by a reader with no context (cloud 11-22): zebra 50 from the silhouette (horse, donkey next) and 95 from the thumbnail. The stripes carry her; the body and legs are a horse's. No critique is recorded for this sheet, so the rubric says 'not ready' (pending the species read).

The mane stops about halfway up the neck (`shape:mane_reach`, soft, above). A proposal runs it to the poll with filly proportions: design/proposals/zuri-v5/ (mane reach 0.86, a slightly bigger head and shorter barrel; blind read zebra 60; passes every motion check). Your call: v5 or keep v4.
zuri.runners: Runner-up 1 is a bigger head and eyes; runner-up 2 has bigger eyes, a shorter snout and a thinner neck. Both scored 10.0 without a species read.
zuri.ask: nothing: locked v4 (brush mane) per your 11-18 plan; notes still welcome
